name: Pelican Hill Golf Club (The Resort at Pelican Hill)
centre_source: golf club point 33.5849264, -117.8418673 from OpenGolfAPI (course data from OpenStreetMap) and 33.585278, -117.841644 from Wander Golf; golf club 22800 Pelican Hill Rd S, resort 22701 Pelican Hill Rd S (geocoded 33.593782, -117.852537 by where2golf). The download box is centred between them at 33.5890, -117.8450, 4.0 x 4.0 km; no course map with coordinates was read, so DATA_REQUEST step 1 checks it
renovations: Fazio 're-perfection' of both courses: closed 23 months 2005-2007, reopened November 2007 (hybrid Bermuda fairways and tees, rough to fescue/rye, bunkers changed or added, new irrigation, new driving range; SCGA FORE)

Brian Curley restoration 2025-2026: bunkers rebuilt and realigned, tees enlarged, green surrounds, Poa greens back to original shapes, trees replanted, vegetation cleared for ocean views, ~1 mile of cart paths; routing unchanged. Ocean South reopened mid-May 2026 (holes 4-12 reworked; fescued sand area on 7, sandy scrub to the tee on 11); Ocean North holes 1-3 and 13-18 closed, reopening November 2026 (SCGA FORE; FirstCallGolf 2026-10-02)
notable: Golf Digest Best in State: Ocean South and Ocean North
Top 100 Golf Courses: Ocean North 43rd, Ocean South 45th in California
video_games: Links 2003 (Microsoft): 'Pelican Hill Golf Club (2003)', a real-course recreation listed on Links Corner (file Pelic2k3.crz, 2002); which course isn't stated, and it predates the 2005-07 rework
tees_note: yards from GolfPass (= the resort's Black yardages); ratings/slopes GolfPass and SCGA agree; tee pars from SCGA (GolfPass prints 70/71 for every tee); SCGA yardages differ slightly (scorecard_sources.md)
default_tee: Blue (Ocean South 6,323 yd, 70.6/130; Ocean North 6,563 yd, 71.6/132)
theme: socal (shared palette notes with Strawberry Farms) or a course theme pelican_hill
special_ground: coastal sage scrub in canyons and on slopes (California gnatcatcher habitat: the original permit required 13.7 acres); canyon carries on South 18 (twice) and North 6, 17, 18; canyon right of North 5's green; barranca right on North 3; scrub on South 15, 18 and North 7, 9, 17, 18. Local rules (penalty area / ESA) not found
fescued sand area on South 7 and sandy scrub to the tee on South 11 (2026, after the data): waste ground
ice plant: not confirmed by any source read
South 13 has two greens (left and right)
water: a pond or stream on South 7 (right side) and North 17 (right side); a 'hazard' on South 5's aggressive line (type unknown). The Pacific lies beyond Pacific Coast Highway and Crystal Cove State Park, probably outside the boundary
